metadata.question: Were there two isolated islands within a 2 km radius of (27.245974, 140.878144) on December 8, 2013?

1. Search strategy: Use Landsat 8 L2 (C02) over a 2 km radius around point (27.245974, 140.878144). Target date: 2013-12-08. If no image in [2013-12-01, 2013-12-15], widen to ±30 days. Fallback to Landsat 7 L2, then Landsat 8 C01 SR if needed. Pick the image with lowest cloud fraction over ROI.
2. Masking strategy: Use QA_PIXEL to mask clouds, cirrus, cloud shadows, and fill. Compute NDWI from scaled surface reflectance; water = NDWI > 0.1; land = not water. Filter small clusters with connectedPixelCount to avoid noise.
3. Logic: If collections empty -> C1. If valid pixels after masking = 0 -> C2. If histogram is null/NaN or failures -> C3. If exactly two land components >= threshold -> A, else B.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function eeGet(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.evaluate((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else resolve(res);
      });
    });
  }

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const lat = 27.245974;
    const lon = 140.878144;
    const targetDate = '2013-12-08';
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(2000);
    const initialStart = '2013-12-01';
    const initialEnd = '2013-12-15';
    const widenedStart = '2013-11-08';
    const widenedEnd = '2013-12-28';
    const ndwiThresh = 0.1;
    const minIslandArea_m2 = 5000; // ~0.5 ha
    const scale = 30;

    console.log(`Target: ${lat.toFixed(6)}, ${lon.toFixed(6)}; Date: ${targetDate}; ROI: 2000 m`);

    // 2. Helper functions for collections, masking, scaling, and image scoring
    const L8L2 = 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2';
    const L7L2 = 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2';
    const L8C01 = 'LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1_SR';

    function maskL2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const notFill = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0);
      const notDilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0);
      const notCirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0);
      const notCloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0);
      const notShadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0);
      const mask = notFill.and(notDilated).and(notCirrus).and(notCloud).and(notShadow);
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function maskL8C01(img) { // QA for C01 SR: 'pixel_qa'
      const qa = img.select('pixel_qa');
      const clear = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0); // clear bit
      const notCloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0) // clear implies not cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // cloud shadow
      return img.updateMask(clear.and(notCloud));
    }
    function scaleL2(img, sensor) {
      // Scale SR_B* to reflectance
      let bands;
      if (sensor === 'L8') {
        bands = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
                   .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
                   .rename(['blue','green','red','nir','swir1','swir2']);
      } else { // L7
        bands = img.select(['SR_B1','SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B7'])
                   .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
                   .rename(['blue','green','red','nir','swir1','swir2']);
      }
      return img.addBands(bands, null, true);
    }

    function annotateCloudFrac(img, isL2) {
      // Count total and cloud px over ROI for ranking
      if (isL2) {
        const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
        const notFill = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0);
        const clouds = qa.bitwiseAnd((1 << 1) | (1 << 2) | (1 << 3) | (1 << 4)).gt(0);
        const tot = ee.Image(1).updateMask(notFill).rename('c').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('c');
        const cld = ee.Image(1).updateMask(clouds.and(notFill)).rename('c').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('c');
        const frac = ee.Number(cld).divide(ee.Number(tot)).multiply(100);
        return img.set({'roi_total_px': tot, 'roi_cloud_px': cld, 'roi_cloud_pct': frac});
      } else {
        // For C01 SR, approximate using mask after maskL8C01: valid vs masked
        const masked = img.updateMask(ee.Image(1)); // ensure mask present
        const valid = ee.Image(1).updateMask(masked.mask()).rename('v').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('v');
        // Use system cloud cover as proxy if available
        const sc = ee.Number(img.get('CLOUD_COVER_LAND')).or(ee.Number(img.get('CLOUD_COVER')));
        return img.set({'roi_total_px': valid, 'roi_cloud_px': null, 'roi_cloud_pct': sc});
      }
    }

    function pickBestImage(col, isL2) {
      col = col.map(img => annotateCloudFrac(img, isL2))
               .sort('roi_cloud_pct', true);
      return col.first();
    }

    async function getBestImage(start, end) {
      // Try L8 L2
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(L8L2).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
      let size = await eeGet(col.size());
      console.log(`L8 L2 images: ${size} (${start}..${end})`);
      if (size > 0) {
        const img = pickBestImage(col, true);
        return {img, sensor: 'L8L2'};
      }
      // Try L7 L2
      col = ee.ImageCollection(L7L2).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
      size = await eeGet(col.size());
      console.log(`L7 L2 images: ${size} (${start}..${end})`);
      if (size > 0) {
        const img = pickBestImage(col, true);
        return {img, sensor: 'L7L2'};
      }
      // Try L8 C01 SR
      col = ee.ImageCollection(L8C01).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
      size = await eeGet(col.size());
      console.log(`L8 C01 SR images: ${size} (${start}..${end})`);
      if (size > 0) {
        const img = pickBestImage(col, false);
        return {img, sensor: 'L8C01'};
      }
      return {img: null, sensor: null};
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Check
    let {img, sensor} = await getBestImage(initialStart, initialEnd);
    if (!img) {
      console.log('No images in initial window, widening...');
      ({img, sensor} = await getBestImage(widenedStart, widenedEnd));
    }
    if (!img) {
      console.log('No images found near date/location.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Processing
    // Mask and scale
    let processed;
    if (sensor === 'L8L2') {
      processed = maskL2(img);
      processed = scaleL2(processed, 'L8');
    } else if (sensor === 'L7L2') {
      processed = maskL2(img);
      processed = scaleL2(processed, 'L7');
    } else {
      processed = maskL8C01(img);
      // C01 SR reflectance already scaled to 0.0001; convert to 0-1
      processed = processed.addBands(
        processed.select(['B2','B3','B4','B5','B6','B7']).multiply(0.0001)
          .rename(['blue','green','red','nir','swir1','swir2']), null, true
      );
    }

    const dateStr = await eeGet(ee.Date(processed.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    const roiTotalPx = await eeGet(ee.Image(1).updateMask(processed.mask()).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).values().get(0));
    if (!roiTotalPx || roiTotalPx === 0) {
      console.log(`Selected image: ${dateStr} (${sensor})`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Cloud stats using QA where available (approx for C01)
    let cloudPx = null, cloudPct = null;
    if (sensor === 'L8L2' || sensor === 'L7L2') {
      const qa = processed.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const notFill = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0);
      const clouds = qa.bitwiseAnd((1 << 1) | (1 << 2) | (1 << 3) | (1 << 4)).gt(0);
      cloudPx = await eeGet(ee.Image(1).updateMask(clouds.and(notFill)).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
      }).values().get(0));
      cloudPx = cloudPx || 0;
      cloudPct = (cloudPx / roiTotalPx) * 100.0;
    } else {
      cloudPct = await eeGet(ee.Number(processed.get('roi_cloud_pct')));
    }

    // NDWI and land mask
    const ndwi = processed.expression(
      '(g - n) / (g + n)', { g: processed.select('green'), n: processed.select('nir') }
    ).rename('ndwi');
    const water = ndwi.gt(ndwiThresh).rename('water').clip(roi);
    const land = water.not().selfMask().clip(roi);

    // Filter small components
    const pxArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().clip(roi);
    const minPix = ee.Number(minIslandArea_m2).divide(900).ceil(); // ~30m px area
    const cpc = land.connectedPixelCount(256, true);
    const largeLand = land.updateMask(cpc.gte(minPix));

    // Label and count components
    const labels = largeLand.connectedComponents(ee.Kernel.plus(1), 256).select('labels');
    const histDict = await eeGet(labels.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.frequencyHistogram(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('labels'));

    // Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Selected image: ${dateStr} (${sensor})`);
    if (cloudPct !== null) {
      console.log(`Valid px: ${roiTotalPx}, Cloud px: ${cloudPx !== null ? cloudPx : 'NA'}, Cloud %: ${cloudPct !== null ? cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
    } else {
      console.log(`Valid px: ${roiTotalPx}`);
    }
    console.log(`NDWI> ${ndwiThresh}, Min island area: ${minIslandArea_m2} m2`);

    if (histDict === null) {
      console.log('Component histogram is null.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const islandCount = Object.keys(histDict).length;
    console.log(`Island count (>= threshold): ${islandCount}`);

    if (!isFinite(islandCount)) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (islandCount === 2) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0, 200)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
